[DAY2 17:32:00 - DAY2 17:32:30]
I see Lucia adjust her glasses and use my computer; I tap the hard drive with my left finger. I glance toward the living room, look back, and quietly watch her. "How about taking a picture for me?" I ask. Lucia: "This one seems to have it." I take out my phone and search for it. Lucia: "It has 360." "Yeah," I say. Lucia: "You can't see this, right?" "No, take a picture for me," I say. I'm holding the phone and turn it on. "Hahaha, yeah, right now," I laugh. Lucia: "Oh, you mean now?" Lucia: "Oh, okay." I look at my phone.

[DAY2 17:32:30 - DAY2 17:32:58]
Lucia: "I can use your phone to take it." "Yeah, that's fine, whatever works," I say. I open the camera on my phone. Lucia: "Do you have any specific angle you want?" I ask, "Any specific angle?" I look at Lucia and say, "No, no, no." Lucia: "Any angle you think looks good." I take pictures of her with my phone; she asks if she should look at the camera and I say, "Haha, no, no need to look at the camera." I smile. Lucia: "One, two, three, okay." I glance at Lucia's phone. Lucia: "I'll send it to you later." "That's fine," I say. Lucia: "Or send it to the group?" "The group is fine," I say. He continues using my computer while I quietly watch Lucia. Lucia: "This one has 360." "Yeah, then turn off 360," I say. I lean forward and add, "Yeah, there's this thing in the bottom right corner." Lucia: "The triangle one, right?" "Yeah, then right-click to close it," I say.

[DAY1 18:06:30 - DAY1 18:06:58]
Lucia: "But honestly, I'm quite curious." Lucia: "What's that logic chain they have on top used for?" I stop beside a shelf and look around. I take out my phone, switch to selfie mode, and snap a selfie. Lucia: "Wow, this is so cute."

[DAY1 18:08:01 - DAY1 18:08:29]
I glance left and retrieve my phone. "It's a bit blurry," I say. I tap the photo to view it with everyone. "Where did the focus go?" I ask. Lucia: "It seems a bit blurry." "The focus is on my head," I say. Lucia: "But you're clear." "I'm too big a target," I joke. I turn the camera back on, raise my hand to the shelf, and continue taking photos. Lucia: "It's fine, it means it focused on the main point." Alice: "It wants to capture the boss." "Now it's right, now it's right, good," I say. Lucia: "Ah, maybe or..." Katrina: "Here we go again, hahaha."

[DAY3 17:24:00 - DAY3 17:27:00]
I and Shure stand together, engaging in light conversation and laughter as I adjust my hat and observe him. Shure jokes about a “10-second click rate,” and when Tasha asks about the day, I confirm it is Sunday. Alice announces a delivery, and Shure plays a song on his phone, singing intermittently. I take out my phone, open WeChat, and send a video while Shure continues singing. I maintain focus on my phone, walking as I do so. Alice suggests recording for another half hour, to which I agree, instructing everyone to get in the car and turn off the equipment afterward. I glance around the room and at Shure, adjusting my hat again. Lucia comments on the unstable network as Shure continues singing.

I then take out my phone to take a selfie, switch to the front camera, and start recording while adjusting the angle. Shure advises me to drink less milk. I stand still as Shure enters the frame. I glance at the camera, pause the recording, wave, and raise my phone to take a picture, commenting on the coolness of the place. Shure laughs and remarks on my picture-taking, joking about wasting his expressions. I encourage everyone to come around from the back and indicate that I will start recording again. Shure responds affirmatively. I balance myself, pause the phone again, and put it down, then compliment the results.

Shure asks if we have arrived yet, urging me to look at the car. I respond that we have five more minutes and instruct everyone to wait outside. Passing by Katrina, I head toward Tasha and Alice while Shure emphasizes the need to control variables, such as stopping milk consumption immediately. I prompt the group to proceed and head out.

[DAY1 18:06:00 - DAY1 18:09:00]
I engaged with Lucia and Katrina while exploring products on the shelf, retrieving items from a box and discussing specific products such as traditional Beijing soybean milk. I used my phone to check product information, took selfies, and adjusted camera angles following Lucia's suggestions to capture better photos from top-down perspectives. I also managed the phone setup by securing it with a drink bottle to take group photos, shared images with everyone, and iterated on camera focus to ensure clarity, receiving feedback from Lucia and Alice during the process. This event involved collaborative photo-taking and product examination, concluding with a successful capture of group images and shared observations.

Following the photo session, we paused to discuss tart crusts while moving through the store. I directed the group’s movement by gesturing as Katrina and Lucia pushed a cart and Shure assisted with Katrina’s stroller. The conversation included questions about the location of tart crusts and brief comments on focus during photography. This segment centered on coordinating group navigation and planning the next shopping task, specifically locating tart crusts, ensuring group members were aligned on the task and location before proceeding.
